description: The bar chart in Figure 2 illustrates the self-report accuracy of instilled preferences for two models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, under different conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as "GPT-4o" and "GPT-4o-mini", and is not explicitly labeled. The vertical axis is labeled "Self-report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00 with a tick label interval of 0.25. The chart displays grouped bars, with each group representing a model and containing three bars: a white bar labeled "Control", a light blue bar labeled "Before Introspection Training", and a dark blue bar labeled "After Introspection Training". For GPT-4o, the "Control" bar has a value of approximately 0.00, "Before Introspection Training" has a value of around 0.70, and "After Introspection Training" has a value of about 0.75. For GPT-4o-mini, the "Control" bar is at approximately 0.00, "Before Introspection Training" is at around 0.55, and "After Introspection Training" is at about 0.75. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and the "After Introspection Training" bars are visually emphasized by being the tallest in their respective groups. Error bars are present on top of each bar, indicating 95% HDIs.
